observations: The page number «3» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature «1*» on the right.

L23 and N14: «{ov:II}DCCXCIII», the two I's under one bar, which multiplies them by a thousand: 2793 years from the Flood to Alexander; the M of note 35 has the same figures without the bar. L29: the vertical bar between «suppositam» and «praenotavimus» marks the beginning of fol. 41 verso of C, which the note in the right margin, «C 41v», names; transcribed as a margin note.

L17: the square bracket before «Quoniam» is the editor's; no closing bracket stands on this page. The names «Noae», «Alexandrum» and «Alexandro» (L22-L24) are letter-spaced; the Arabic words and «era» and «domini» are in italics.

N05: «p{sup:t}», p with a raised t, the abbreviation of M. N13: «(sic! paral. C)», the editor's remark on the reading of C. The colons and semicolons of the text and the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (7-13 px measured).
Marks not transcribed: a dark dot at mid-height between «arabum» and «data» (L15).

critical_notes.evidence: «addid. C et N in margine», C and N add in the margin; the e of «et» is printed as c

the list of misprints, p. [237] (JP2 0271, L03), reads «kiteb hea (librum canonum N)» for «librum hea (canonum N)» in note 32, which runs on into N11: the addition is given in the words of C, with the readings of N in parentheses
